data.description:
Bootstrap story added by adversarial review. Creates dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh that idempotently creates the three tracking tickets (calibration-program-health, mutation-history, suite-churn-history) if they do not exist. Documents the one-time setup step. Adds a CI preflight check in calibration-rollup.yml (story for draft-7) that runs the bootstrap guard at workflow start. Without this story, the first CI run always fails because the tracking tickets don't exist — making it impossible to distinguish first-run-expected-failure from real ticket deletion.

## Done Definitions

- dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh creates all three tracking tickets (calibration-program-health, mutation-history, suite-churn-history) when they do not exist, and is a no-op when they already exist ← Satisfies: sc-6
- .claude/scripts/dso ticket exists calibration-program-health && .claude/scripts/dso ticket exists mutation-history && .claude/scripts/dso ticket exists suite-churn-history returns exit 0 after the script runs ← Satisfies: sc-6
- calibration-rollup.yml (GHA workflow story) runs the bootstrap guard as a preflight step so the first CI run succeeds rather than failing with a missing-ticket error ← Satisfies: sc-6
- dso-bootstrap-calibration-tickets.sh has the executable bit set in git (mode 100755) ← Satisfies: sc-6

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Use idempotent ticket create — check exists before create, not create-then-ignore-error, so the script is safe to run multiple times without side effects.
- [Documentation] Document the bootstrap step in the skill/workflow README so operators who clone the repo fresh know to run it before enabling calibration-rollup.yml.

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked
data.title: As CI, I want the three calibration tracking tickets bootstrapped before the first calibration-rollup workflow run, so that the workflow's missing-ticket CI failure is meaningful rather than always-failing.
